single.rationale: PHATHOM shows promising commercial traction with VOQUEZNA revenue growing 217% to $175M in FY2025 and strong 87% gross margins, but faces significant cash burn ($167M negative FCF), deteriorating balance sheet (cash down to $130M, negative equity of -$438M), and continued heavy operating losses despite cost reductions. Management projects profitability in Q3 2026, but execution risk remains high for this early-stage commercial pharma company.
